releaseChain.stopUnless: Both commands exit zero and M66 remains appliedToProduction false with managedMigrationId PENDING.

releaseChain.action: Apply the exact reviewed M66 bytes to production in their own transaction
releaseChain.stopUnless: The embedded preflight observes exact canonical M65 1..20 bands and the transaction exits zero.

releaseChain.stopUnless: Exact M66, M61, money, duplicate, target_count, target_set_md5, historical_release_md5, and founder_checkout_md5 checks pass.

The command exits zero and appends exactly the prechecked candidates without update, delete, downgrade, resurrection, or invention.
Every current approved unit is at least 50, all new rows have exact predecessors and carried fields, and historical releases plus founder checkout hashes are unchanged.

releaseChain.action: Rerun the same authority write as an idempotency proof
releaseChain.command: Repeat release-chain order 10 with the same bound variables, then repeat order 11.
releaseChain.stopUnless: Both commands exit zero and the second write appends zero rows.

releaseChain.command: Exercise quantities 1, 20, 21, 49, 50, and 51 through the production client, quote, checkout, persistence, invoice, settlement, and child-release path.
releaseChain.stopUnless: 1, 20, 21, 49, and 50 succeed with exact server money and one canonical order; 51 is refused at every ingress; duplicate submissions replay rather than create another active checkout.
